title: My Jobs list
guidance: Human annotations include older and current versions. Validate against current source before applying a change.
New human feedback covers job-card badge placement, option dividers and the no-active-jobs icon/header alignment.
Latest human direction: stable intrinsic My Jobs heading coordinates between recovery/loading/normal views; long titles bounded in list and complete in job detail. Revisit C06 feedback tone.

Latest human correction: make compact arrow paging hover more noticeable. Use a soft tonal circular fill plus a fine inset edge on enabled Previous/Next. This icon-navigation exception does not change quiet text-button hover.

decisions.title: Shared manual-review corrections applied
decisions.reason: This page uses the linked component decisions. Its human review is limited to the states explicitly marked below; US028/US034 patterns were extrapolated without claiming whole-page human acceptance.

decisions.title: 1.8 stable heading and bounded job names
decisions.reason: My Jobs begins at the same intrinsic page origin in normal/loading/recovery views. Desktop filter aligns to the heading group start; no fixed screenshot coordinates. Job result titles show up to two lines; View job exposes full survey names in the actual detail.

decisions.title: Discoverable compact pagination hover
decisions.reason: Shared compact+quiet recipe covers My Jobs and Reviews. Rest is transparent/borderless, targets do not shift, focus remains explicit, touch does not retain hover and reduced motion keeps static feedback.

parameters.name: Story ownership
parameters.description: Scenario state, eligibility, copy and intrinsic composition remain owned here. Shared theme/recipes own reusable appearance.

parameters.name: Compact icon hover
parameters.description: Enabled compact quiet icons use a tonal circle and inset hairline on pointer hover. Quiet text controls remain transparent.
